result: Two actual native defects have narrow source repairs reviewed clear; native GREEN remains pending. Initial missed uppercase edge and first 8/11 run are retained.

checks.evidence: Pure operations select an exact existing drawing boundary/index in a detached validated graph, change only that stroke or remove it, then validate the complete candidate including coordinate/count/canonical byte limits. Translation never clamps or resamples points. Hit testing traverses reverse paint order and includes round segment endpoints and degenerate paths.

Mode/canvas/stroke action pointer handlers prevent native blur when other raw editor fields refuse admission. Current helper additionally protects unrelated raw fields on Discard while allowing deliberate disposal of stroke scratch only. Color/width input retires async/tween intent and explicitly rebinds its selected target; unrelated input retires selection without replacing raw scratch. Width parsing occurs only on explicit Apply.

Target identity includes project object, layer, frame, exact cel/index, generation and operation. Own edits explicitly rebind after existing commit; unrelated intent retires the selection. Appearance same-value/return-to-start translation reaches the existing canonical History.commit no-op path, preserving Redo and avoiding scheduleSave. Delete clears selection rather than retargeting the shifted index.
checks.qualification: This initial reasoning did not cover native color-input lowercasing of accepted uppercase project strings; see reopened uppercase-color-noop finding.

checks.evidence: Gesture captures original project/pose/cel/geometry, derives each rigid delta from original client coordinates, and checks actual pointerup coordinates before commit. Invalid movement cancels the whole gesture. Pointer ID, primary admission, lost capture, canvas/window blur, scroll capture, resize, hidden/pagehide and new input are covered. Keyboard operations are restricted to edit mode with canvas/list focus, ignore repeats and exclude editable fields/modifier shortcuts.

New edits use only existing history/commit/autosave/library-conflict boundaries. Generation/operation changes retire pending imported/recovered project publication; save status/catalog updates call controls without rebuilding stroke raw fields. No new storage authority or persistence schema is introduced.

Selection overlay occupies a separate transparent pointer-events-none canvas. Existing PNG private canvas and GIF worker use committed project plus the untouched shared renderer, so overlay/selection/gesture scratch do not enter artifacts. Preview displacement changes only the selected active cel; layer poses and other cels/images remain in the validated base graph.

findings.trigger: Select a stroke with accepted imported color #0000FF, then Apply its unchanged appearance after native color input exposes #0000ff.
findings.impact: setStrokeAppearance currently receives the lowercased native value, so canonical project text differs despite unchanged RGB/width. Existing History.commit can create an unintended edit/save and truncate Redo.
findings.expected: Unchanged RGB and width preserve the exact committed stroke graph, Redo and save state. Preserve committed color spelling when the selected RGB is equivalent; genuine RGB changes remain explicit edits.
findings.discovery: Root identified the omitted edge after initial clear review. Recorder confirmed the source seam and held the fix for an independently authored uppercase native regression.
findings.runtimeEvidence: First native uppercase case observed exact #0000FF becoming #0000ff on unchanged Apply.
findings.repairReview: stroke-editor.ts compares the native color value with committed.color.toLowerCase(); RGB equality reuses the exact committed string, while different RGB still passes the chosen native value to the original pure candidate validator. No history/save suppression is added; canonical graph equality reaches the established no-op path.
